name: langmail-mcp
stderr:
The self-hosted Langmail MCP server cannot start.
Missing settings:
  STALWART_URL (--stalwart-url): the base URL of your Stalwart server, e.g. https://mail.example.com
  STALWART_USERNAME (--username): the account name you sign in to Stalwart with
  STALWART_PASSWORD: an app password for that account (environment only, so it stays out of the process list)
Usage: langmail-mcp [--transport stdio|http] [--stalwart-url URL] [--username NAME] [--email ADDRESS]
         [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--public-url URL]
Secrets come from the environment only: STALWART_PASSWORD, and MCP_AUTH_TOKEN for http.
langmail-mcp --help lists every setting.
